reason: `Stop` records "service is stopping"/"service is stopped" in `s.initErr` (pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:321,339), but the patch removed the `s.Init(ctx)` guard that surfaced it, so `IsHealthy` now only delegates to `s.diagnostics.IsHealthy` (server.go:934-935). That delegate returns SERVING unconditionally for the default noop (noop.go:27-31) or whenever the DB ping succeeds for the SQL backend (pkg/storage/unified/sql/backend.go:109-117), whose `Stop` only cancels a context.
